subject: ela
cluster: Range of reading and level of text complexity
intro: Read each passage and pick the answer.

items.prompt:
Read.

She worked three jobs so her brother could finish school.

She is:
A) selfless
B) lazy
C) cruel

Read.

The thunder grumbled like an old man complaining.

This is:
A) personification (and a simile)
B) a fact
C) a summary

To support a claim about a text, you should use:
A) the strongest textual evidence
B) a wild guess
C) the cover price

Read.

Though everyone doubted her, Aisha kept rebuilding the shelter after each storm until it stood.

The theme is:
A) give up when it's hard
B) persistence overcomes obstacles
C) storms are scary

steps: Her persistence pays off. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

'All the world's a stage.'

This compares the world to a stage, so it is a:
A) metaphor
B) summary
C) fact

steps: World IS a stage. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

The story flashes back to the war that shaped him.

This structure is a:
A) flashback
B) cliffhanger
C) climax

Read.

The narrator insists the accident 'wasn't his fault at all,' yet he admits he was speeding, texting, and running late.

The narrator is best described as:
A) reliable
B) unreliable
C) omniscient

steps: His claim contradicts the details. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The tyrant crushed every rival, trusted no one, and died alone, hated by the people he had ruled through fear.

The BEST theme is:
A) Rulers should be feared.
B) Ruling through cruelty and fear breeds hatred and isolation.
C) Castles are cold.
items.answer: B) Ruling through cruelty and fear breeds hatred and isolation.

steps: His choices lead to his end. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) Ruling through cruelty and fear breeds hatred and isolation.
